questions.q: How do you usually travel around?
questions.answer: Mostly by bus and rickshaw for daily trips, and occasionally a ride-share app when I'm in a hurry. It works well enough, though the traffic can turn even a short journey into a real [[ordeal]].

questions.q: Do you often use public transport?
questions.answer: Quite often, yes, mainly buses and the occasional rickshaw for shorter trips. It's affordable and saves the stress of parking, although it can get [[congested]] during peak hours, which is the main downside.

questions.q: How do you usually get to work?
questions.answer: Usually by rickshaw, since the office is only a short ride from home. On pleasant mornings I sometimes walk instead. It's a fairly [[stress-free]] commute compared to what my elder sister faces in Dhaka traffic.

questions.q: Is traffic a problem where you live?
questions.answer: Very much so, especially in the bigger cities. Congestion during rush hour is genuinely frustrating and eats into everyone's day. I think better public transport is really the only [[viable]] long-term solution.

questions.q: Would you like to own a car one day?
questions.answer: Perhaps eventually, mainly for family trips to our village. For now, though, it isn't really necessary, and the running costs are quite high. A motorbike might be a more [[sensible compromise]] in the meantime.
